parameters.name: Forced
parameters.description: Specifies whether to forcibly decouple the standby instance.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the primary instance.

parameters.name: TargetInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the standby instance to be decoupled.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oceanbasepro remove-standby-instance --instance-id ob608fgj1q0000 --target-instance-id ob4bv8o7sp0000 --forced false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oceanbasepro RemoveStandbyInstance --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId ob608fgj1q0000 --TargetInstanceId ob4bv8o7sp0000 --Forced false
